intent: Implement Evolution Expert 2.0.0 as the independently versioned mandatory ordinary-human entry installed into qualified Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, generic Agent, and generic MCP Hosts, using one Agent-neutral Core and Runtime-owned MCP facts for every project, Lifecycle, Harness-guided Loop, recovery, acceptance, and release journey.
objective: Deliver a stateless non-authoritative Evolution Expert 2.0.0 that makes EvoPilot Runtime 6.0.0 understandable and operable through conversational Host Integration Bundles without requiring users to know CLI, HTTP, MCP tool names, digests, or schemas and without owning Runtime truth, Harness assets, execution, credentials, or authority.

evidence.authority: Exact authorization to apply the v6 Roadmap and draft/preflight this Target; not Target approval or implementation authority.
Current authoritative machine Roadmap declaring Expert 2.0.0 mandatory ordinary-human entry.
Approved replacement Expert/Host/Runtime architecture boundary; not implementation evidence.
Published Expert 1.0.1 compatibility baseline inherited criterion by criterion.
Superseded unreleased development evidence only; its Candidate evidence cannot prove Expert 2.0 acceptance.

include: Implement one Agent-neutral conversational Core and deterministic generated Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, generic Agent, and generic MCP Host Integration Bundles.

Use Runtime MCP facts and schemas to guide discovery, tutorial, project onboarding, Lifecycle CRUD, Harness matching, combined planning, Goal Target Loop, progress, evidence, recovery, acceptance, release, upgrade, and rollback journeys.
Implement installed bundle doctor, health, version, compatibility, upgrade, rollback, removal, help, and documentation routing.
Preserve Runtime-owned durable truth, exact decision frames, restart/resume, cross-Host transfer, and finite next actions without trusting conversation history.
Prove real Codex and Claude Code installation, designated-human WorkBuddy, independent Host, generic MCP, headless degraded recovery, exact Candidate pairing, impact closure, and NO_REGRESSION.
Synchronize Expert README, quickstart, tutorials, Host integration, Lifecycle management, Harness-guided Loop, security, recovery, troubleshooting, versioning, and migration documentation.
exclude: No Runtime, project, Lifecycle, Harness, Goal, Target, Loop, evidence, recovery, acceptance, release, credential, or durable-state ownership in Expert.
No Harness selection, fabrication, reasoning, authoring, mutation, approval, Catalog, Registry, signing, or publication authority.
No embedded coding Agent, direct project source execution, raw credential storage, or bypass of qualified external Agent Runtime.
No Host-specific business, Lifecycle, authority, recovery, or durable-state semantics; adapters remain generated thin clients.
No lockstep version coupling among Expert, Runtime, Lifecycle resources, Host bundles, Harness assets, or frozen Suite fixtures.
No Codex operation or observation of designated-human WorkBuddy.
No direct ordinary-human CLI or HTTP fallback when Expert is unavailable.
No commit, push, Candidate, E2E, Host operation, publication, or Release under this unapproved draft.

designDecisions.productIdentity: EvoPilot Evolution Expert 2.0.0 Agent Host Entry
designDecisions.stateModel: stateless presentation over Runtime durable truth
designDecisions.adapterModel: one Core generates all Host Integration Bundles
designDecisions.authorityModel: Expert renders exact Runtime decision frames and never infers authority
designDecisions.executionBoundary: Expert never performs source execution; qualified external Agent Runtime does

acceptance.criterion: One Agent-neutral Expert Core deterministically generates Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, generic Agent, and generic MCP Host Integration Bundles.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Generator determinism, one-Core-digest, package, and adapter conformance evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Expert discovers Runtime MCP health, protocol, version, capabilities, Host compatibility, and installed documentation before guiding an operation.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Exact installed Runtime/Expert discovery transcripts and mismatch diagnostics.

acceptance.criterion: Expert guides project and Lifecycle create, list, inspect, resolve, diff, successor update, activate, deactivate, archive, restore, rollback, dependency, usage, and audit journeys.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: MCP journey matrix against Runtime-owned objects.

acceptance.criterion: Expert guides Harness match, combined plan, Goal Target Loop, pendingExecution progress, evidence, recovery, acceptance, and release decision frames without inventing facts or transitions.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Golden conversation and Runtime-fact binding tests.

acceptance.criterion: Expert discovers and validates inputs before asking, asks only unresolved relevant questions, and clearly separates parameters, readiness, decisions, and authority.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Schema-driven dialogue, progressive disclosure, and negative approval-inference tests.

acceptance.criterion: Expert resumes after Runtime or Host restart and transfers across Hosts solely from Runtime state rather than chat history.
Host Integration Bundle exposes install, doctor, health, version, upgrade, rollback, removal, tutorial, and help metadata for each supported Host.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Installed bundle lifecycle tests and documentation verification.

acceptance.criterion: Every response presents one coherent result and finite next action, with at most one unresolved human question unless an explicit typed batch is safer.
Expert is stateless and non-authoritative: it owns no project, Lifecycle, Harness, Goal, Target, Loop, evidence, recovery, acceptance, release, credential, or durable Runtime truth.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Architecture guards, restart tests, storage scan, and authority tests.

acceptance.criterion: Expert never selects, fabricates, authors, mutates, approves, or publishes Harness assets and cannot weaken Harness obligations.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Negative Harness authority and composition tests.

acceptance.criterion: Expert never executes source work, embeds a general coding Agent, stores raw credentials, or bypasses qualified external Agent Runtime dispatch.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Dependency, tool, credential, and execution boundary tests.

acceptance.criterion: Codex and Claude Code preserve identical Core and MCP semantics; WorkBuddy remains designated-human operated without Codex observation.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Real Host conformance plus frozen WorkBuddy human declaration.

acceptance.criterion: A future Agent Host can qualify through the public Host Integration Bundle contract without Runtime or Expert Core source changes.
Expert versioning, Candidate, acceptance, release, upgrade, and rollback remain independent of Runtime and declarative Lifecycle versions.
When Expert or one Host adapter is unavailable, administrator and machine recovery remain possible without silently presenting a direct ordinary-human fallback.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Degraded-mode diagnostics and negative fallback tests.

acceptance.criterion: Expert documentation enables a new ordinary user to install, learn, onboard a project, manage Lifecycles, run a Harness-guided Loop, recover, and understand authority without prior CLI, HTTP, MCP-name, digest, or schema expertise.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Fresh-user documentation journey and installed-artifact link/command checks.

acceptance.criterion: Expert acceptance closes only on exact installed Expert 2.0.0 and compatible Runtime 6.0.0 Candidate evidence with complete inherited, Host, MCP, impact, and NO_REGRESSION closure.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Independent criterion-level completion report and exact Candidate manifests.

regressionImpact.area: Expert 2.0.0 changes the ordinary-human entry and Host Integration contract while preserving every applicable published Expert 1.0.1 guarantee.
regressionImpact.reason: Core generation, Host adapters, dialogue, authority routing, statelessness, documentation, and compatibility may all be affected.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: A new user installs the Codex Host Integration Bundle, discovers Expert through MCP, runs tutorial, onboards an unknown project, and creates its first Lifecycle without CLI knowledge.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Exact installed-Candidate transcript, Core digest, MCP facts, Runtime objects, and zero source diff.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Claude Code installs the generated bundle and inspects the object created in Codex with identical Runtime truth and Expert semantics.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Cross-Host object and response semantic equality evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: A designated human completes the frozen WorkBuddy install and authority journey without Codex operation or observation.
Expert guides complete Lifecycle successor update, diff, activation, deactivation, archive, restore, rollback, dependency, usage, and audit operations.
Expert matches a real HarnessBundle, shows the monotonic combined plan, starts a Goal Target Loop, and renders qualified external Agent Runtime progress and receipt evidence.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Harness, Lifecycle, pendingExecution, receipt, and Loop evidence chain.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Runtime and Host restart, then Expert resumes from durable Runtime state without trusting chat history.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Restart/resume and conversation reconstruction rejection evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: A new independent Agent Host qualifies from the public bundle contract and completes discovery, read, guided mutation preview, and stop behavior without Core changes.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Adapter conformance and repository diff evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Security and authority journey rejects raw secrets, inferred approval, Harness mutation, direct source execution, and publication while returning an exact finite next action.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Adversarial dialogue and Runtime decision-frame evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: Expert upgrades and rolls back independently while remaining compatible with the exact Runtime protocol range.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Host Integration Bundle upgrade/rollback and compatibility evidence.

realCaseCoverage.scenario: With Expert unavailable, machine diagnostics recover Runtime without exposing a silent direct ordinary-human operation path.
realCaseCoverage.requiredEvidence: Degraded-mode recovery and negative fallback evidence.
